exposure: Successful external cephalic version for breech presentation
outcome: Intrapartum intervention rates (emergency cesarean section, instrumental delivery)
Neonatal outcomes (Apgar score <7 at 5 min, abnormal cord gases, resuscitation at birth, admission to NICU)
cohort: 411 women who underwent successful external cephalic version for breech presentation at term, compared to 1236 women with cephalic presentation who underwent spontaneous labor
finding: Women who underwent successful external cephalic version had higher rates of intrapartum interventions and poorer neonatal outcomes compared to women with cephalic presentation who underwent spontaneous labor.
